digest.component_or_area: rebar init CLI and store initialization
propositions: rebar init silently creates an orphan branch when configured tickets fetch fails or times out, making an unreachable remote indistinguishable from a genuinely absent branch

the current tri-state predicate in _mount_or_create_branch and pending_init_attaches_to_existing checks only local refs and local remote-tracking refs, failing to probe remote advertisement before orphaning

explicit init and strict auto-init must distinguish three states: remote advertises branch (attempt bounded fetch), remote reachable but absent (bootstrap orphan), remote unreachable or times out (fail closed without orphaning)
ensure_store_mounted_best_effort must treat unreachable as do-not-auto-mount and return without error, allowing strict auto-init to reuse the cached tri-state result and report actionable failure
a new --force-new-store flag and force_new_store keyword must permit deliberate bootstrap only when reachability cannot be established, with no effect when remote is reachable
